answer: Jade Beacon Admission. At registration, each agent commits an ID hash, then a public beacon emits a verifiable random value binding that ID to a slot in a hidden ordering. Slots open on a willow-scheduled release, so an attacker cannot precompute which IDs land where. Wallets must hold velvet-tier balance frozen per slot until the beacon confirms position. Mass-registering N IDs forces N frozen deposits plus abandoned-slot penalties, making sybil cost linear in N with no precomputation edge.
